phase: Phase 36: Controlled Reliability Migration & Proof Layer

cardinal_principles.cardinal_principle_1: Tools NEVER declare SUCCESS. Only the canonical pipeline evaluates post-condition ground-truth verification contracts to assign terminal status.
cardinal_principles.cardinal_principle_2: Observation != Correction. State drift reconciles the World Model digital twin; autonomous production mutations are strictly prohibited without an explicit operator lease token.
cardinal_principles.zero_false_success_guarantee: Empirical ground-truth verification required for all terminal SUCCESS declarations. 0.0% false-success rate enforced.

stages.name: Discovery & Component Baseline
deliverables: Component inventory cataloging all 30 domain tools and services
Endpoint mapping across REST, WebSocket, MQTT, and CLI gateways
Baseline telemetry capture and health state profiling

stages.name: Contracts & Envelopes Layer
deliverables: ActionEnvelope with 4 safety tiers and 3 execution classes (REFLEX, READ_ONLY, MISSION)
UniversalTransactionRecord (UTR) with deterministic SHA-256 state serialization
Dual-channel VerificationContract enforcing terminal status separation

stages.name: Security Policies & Invariants
deliverables: Dynamic declarative security policies in policies/security_policies.yaml
Fail-closed production secrets manager with automatic dummy fallbacks in DEV
Zero-bypass unauthorized mutation enforcement
Single-use cryptographic lease tokens with replay protection
SSRF and DNS rebinding defense in PromptShield
Pre-logging secret redaction across 10 sensitive pattern classes

stages.name: Canonical Execution Pipeline
deliverables: Single canonical execution pipeline in services/brain/canonical_pipeline.py
Complete 10-step lifecycle: Ingress -> Normalize -> Classify -> Invariants -> Policy -> Execution -> Ground-Truth Verify -> World Model Reconcile -> Audit Settlement -> Response
Three execution classes: REFLEX (<30ms), READ_ONLY (telemetry), MISSION (multi-step mutating)
Hierarchical alias normalization (system.status -> system_telemetry, etc.)
Full pipeline authority: tools prohibited from setting final terminal status

stages.name: Observability & Distributed Tracing
deliverables: W3C Distributed Traceparent context propagation (00-{trace_id}-{span_id}-01)
Per-stage latency breakdown (ingress, policy, execution, verification, settlement)
Prometheus /metrics exporter with requests, duration histograms, and security alerts
Production Grafana dashboard specification in infrastructure/grafana/jarvis_dashboard.json
Deterministic sandboxed event replay engine

stages.name: Verification & Reality Reconciliation
deliverables: Ground-truth VerificationEngine validating process PID existence, file size/hash, and Docker state
Tool honesty enforcement: tool claims contradicted by verification are rejected
Reality reconciliation engine: implements Cardinal Principle 2 (Observation != Correction)
Autonomous mutation strictly prohibited without operator approval lease token
Drift recording to World Model digital twin without unprompted system mutations

stages.name: Cloud, DevOps & DevSecOps Intelligence
deliverables: Terraform plan AST parser with blast-radius tier escalation (destroy actions -> TIER_3_DESTRUCTIVE)
FinOps cost delta estimator with strict $50.00/month approval gate
Kubernetes diagnostician with explicit Item 105 LAB-TESTED maturity designation
DevSecOps supply chain vulnerability scanner (known CVEs, insecure Dockerfile anti-patterns, exposed secrets)

stages.name: Voice, Device, IoT & Browser Intelligence
deliverables: Voice biometric phrase verifier with phonetic challenge-response and speaker distance thresholding
Browser guard blocking SSRF/metadata endpoints, protecting payment forms, and enforcing isolated profiles
IoT offline SQLite persistent spooling buffer with FIFO reconnect draining

stages.name: Mission Resilience & State Recovery
deliverables: ACID SQLite mission persistence engine with transactional checkpointing
Crash recovery engine with automatic startup scanning and idempotent resume
Three-state circuit breaker (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) per tool with alias matching

stages.name: Testing, Chaos & Quality Assurance
deliverables: Comprehensive chaos test suite (MQTT broker partitions, crash recovery, circuit tripping, emergency stand-down, contract tampering)
Soak and memory leak test executing 50 consecutive canonical pipeline turns (<50MB memory delta, zero resource leaks)

stages.name: Benchmark & Flagship Validation
deliverables: 100-Task Master Reliability Benchmark covering Computer, Cloud, and IoT worlds across all 4 safety tiers
Flagship End-to-End Cyber-Physical Demo verifying cross-world orchestration with 77 cryptographically chained audit blocks
Empirically validated 100.0% pass rate and 0.0% false success rate
